## Change

Describe the problem and the smallest coherent solution.

## Security and failure modes

Describe changed trust boundaries, permissions, network destinations, secrets, approvals, rollback or evaluation assumptions.

## Evidence

- [ ] Local test suite passes.
- [ ] New behavior has deterministic positive and negative tests.
- [ ] Contracts/scenarios/docs were updated together when applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, customer telemetry or raw Matrix traces are included.
- [ ] Dependency, image and Action references remain pinned.
- [ ] Performance or model-quality claims include retained runs and independent labels.
